item.title: I have reported this issue and the case has been closed with no explanation, 19th November
item.description:
I received an email today saying that this case is closed but with no explanation or resolution. I know of two accidents in the past 4 weeks due to cars trying to turn past stationary cars waiting at the traffic lights. The exit from the garage needs to be one way only towards Elmbridge Court roundabout to ensure that no further accidents occur. An update would be appreciated not just a closed case

item.title: Parking in restricted area, 19th November
item.description:
Living near Travis Perkins there are parking restrictions outside our house which are ignored constantly, causing a black spot out onto the road. Often Travis Perkins trucks park opposite, for over 30 minutes blocking the view out of our driveway, blocking oncoming traffic. There have been wardens on occasion, which are very helpful with issuing tickets and preventing the return of vehicles for some time, but we haven't seen any for a number of weeks and the illegal parking has returned.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Mead Road, Leckhampton, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet
item.category: Parking restriction road markings and lines
